entities.name: Geneviève Fauconnier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Geneviève Fauconnier was a French novelist who lived in the south of the Charente département (France). She was one of the most sensitive members of the so-called Groupe de Barbezieux. Her brother, Henri Fauconnier and Jacques Chardonne were some of the most famous writers of this group.
